answer: Time-locked ledge attestation.** Each identity must periodically submit a cryptographically signed photo of a physical ledge marker at a distinct karst site, timestamped and geohashed. A sable thread woven through the marker proves presence. The rule: an identity expires unless a fresh, site-unique signature arrives within the window. An attacker must physically visit and photograph thousands of dispersed karst ledges, paying travel and time per identity, which no single operator can fake at scale.
